commands.sources: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/sqruff_rules.py sources

method: Names only; no code. For each rule: the SyntaxKind variants that its file names, as strum snake_case strings (the segment type that sqruff gives). Comments, string literals, and #[cfg(test)] items are removed first. modules: the files that the 'use' items of the rule file name, and again of those files, inside {'sqruff-lib': ('rules/', 'utils/'), 'sqruff-lib-core': ('utils/', 'parser/segments/', 'dialects/common.rs')}, without ['sqruff-lib-core/parser/segments/test_functions.rs']. For sqruff-lib/utils/reflow/config.rs: also the layout types of sqruff-lib/src/core/default_config.cfg. The base segment module sqruff-lib-core/parser/segments.rs is not a helper module: it has the segment type and the generic methods that each rule uses (for example is_whitespace, is_meta, is_comment), not the logic of one rule. As a helper it would add the same names (base_module.names) to most rules and hide the names that are specific to each rule. base_module of a rule: true if a 'use' item of the rule file or of a helper module names it. The crates are those of the cargo cache; their sha256 is the checksum in the Cargo.lock of the sqruff crate. sqlfluff_types: the types and class types of each segment class, parser, and lexer of the dialects of the pinned sqlfluff, and of each segment class of the package.
